title: TaskMaster Pro
description: A complete task management system with color theming

commands_preview.label: Setup Virtual Environment
commands_preview.command_text: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip

commands_preview.label: Install Django Dependencies
commands_preview.command_text: pip install django djangorestframework django-cors-headers python-decouple

commands_preview.label: Create Django Project
commands_preview.command_text: django-admin startproject taskmasterpro . && python manage.py startapp tasks

commands_preview.label: Setup Database
commands_preview.command_text: python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate

commands_preview.label: Create Admin User
commands_preview.command_text: echo "from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model; User = get_user_model(); User.objects.create_superuser('admin', 'admin@taskmaster.com', 'admin123')" | python manage.py shell

commands_preview.label: Initialize Git
commands_preview.command_text:
git init && echo "venv/
*.pyc
__pycache__/
.env
db.sqlite3" > .gitignore && git add . && git commit -m "Initial TaskMaster Pro setup"

commands_preview.label: Start Development Server
commands_preview.command_text: echo "🚀 TaskMaster Pro is ready! Visit http://localhost:8000 to see your app." && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
